description: Ask what cad.monster does with a conversion of a CAD or 3D model file: automatic, done by an engineer after a free estimate, or not offered. Returns the link to the order form to give to the person, and the free limits, timing and prices when the conversion is automatic. Creates nothing: no order is placed, no file is sent.

from.description: Extension of the person's file, for example "stl" or "CATPart".

size_mb.description: Size of the person's files together, in MB. With it the answer names the cheapest option for an automatic conversion of that size.

to.description: Target: an extension ("step") or the name of a program ("solidworks", "3ds max"). Leave out to list every target offered for this source.

name: check_conversion

automatic_conversion.description: For automatic results only: free limits, timing, paid options with prices, and for_size_mb (the cheapest option for the size given).

order_url.description: When "to" is one format: the link to give to the person, the order form with this target chosen.

result.description: The meanings are in the resource https://cad.monster/llms.txt

suggested.description: When "to" is a program: the formats it opens, each with its own result, order_url and upload_to.

targets.description: Without "to": every target format, each with its own result, order_url and upload_to.

upload_to.description: When "to" is one format: the value of "to" for how_to_send_file.

title: Check a conversion
